sentences.text:
Through: Mr.Vivek Pathak, Mr  Kumar, Advocates.
 versus  THE STATE OF NCT AND ANR

Through: Mr.Mukesh Kr, APP   with ASI Gajraj Si  Mr.Mushfique Raja,
 with R2 in person.
CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE YOGESH KHANNA  ORDER % 19.04.2023 1.
This petition is filed for quashing of FIR No.855/2015 under Section 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Gokal Puri, Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom.
2. The marriage between petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 was solemnized on 24.11.2007 as per Muslim rites and ceremonies.
A male child namely Arman was born from the said wedlock who is now 14 years old.
Since 15.08.2014 because of temperamental differences the respondent no.2 started living separately and filed a complaint which culminated into present FIR.
The chargesheet have been filed against the petitioners herein.

3. However, with the intervention of family members and friends the matter has been amicably settled between the parties on 04.02.2023 and in lieu of said settlement the petitioner no.1 agreed to pay an amount of Rs.1.00 lac to the respondent no.2 herein towards all her claims including permanent alimony, maintenance (present, past and future), stridhan etc.
4. The respondent no.2 is present in the Court and has been duly identified by the Investigating Officer and she has no objection in case the FIR is quashed as the matter is settled and she has Aas Mohd And Ors vs The State Of Nct And Anr on 19 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94434011/
1 received the entire settled amount from the petitioners and no claim left of whatsoever nature against the petitioners.

entities.text: Aas Mohd And Ors vs The State Of Nct And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The affidavits of parties are on record.
The learned APP for the State also has no objection in case the FIR is quashed.
The parties have already executed talaknamas on 04.12.2022; 04.01.2023 and 04.02.2023 and their divorce has been complete as per shariat law.
5. In view of the above, there is no impediment in quashing the present FIR as the matter is settled between the parties and it would never entail in conviction of the petitioners herein.
6. Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.855/2015 under Section 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Gokal Puri, Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom stands quashed.
Pending application(s), if any, also stands disposed of.
This settlement would not affect the rights of the son of petitioner no.1, which he may intend to exercise in future.

YOGESH KHANNA, J.
APRIL 19, 2023 DU Aas Mohd And Ors vs The State Of Nct And Anr on 19 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94434011/
